March of Giants | Official Premiere – Pioneer Playtest
March of Giants is gearing up for war! Join us October 7 for an exclusive look at the game, what's coming next, and how you can play. Set your reminder now!

March of Giants is a free-to-play 4v4 MOBA where you lead an army, not just a hero. Play as a towering Giant, rally hundreds of Soldiers, and deploy Battleworks that turn familiar lanes into shifting front lines. Master your abilities, lead your army, reshape the battlefield, and take your team to victory.
 
Join the Pioneer Playtest on Steam [https://store.steampowered.com/app/1924600/March_of_Giants/]

#Ubisoft #MarchofGiants

About Ubisoft:

Ubisoft is a creator of worlds, committed to enriching players’ lives with original and memorable entertainment experiences. Ubisoft’s global teams create and develop a deep and diverse portfolio of games, featuring brands such as Assassin’s Creed®, Brawlhalla®, For Honor®, Far Cry®, Tom Clancy’s Ghost Recon®, Just Dance®, Rabbids®, Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six®, The Crew® and Tom Clancy’s The Division®. With a Ubisoft+ subscription, players can access new releases, premium editions and extra content on Day One on PC, console and cloud. For the 2024-25 fiscal year, Ubisoft generated net bookings of €1.85 billion. To learn more, please visit: www.ubisoftgroup.com.

Riders Republic: Season 20 Launch Trailer
Season 20 is live now in Riders Republic! This season is packed full of awesome content. Two iconic Scooter brands join the adventure, Ethic and Envy, alongside our Full Send model. But that’s not all! Riders Republic is celebrating its 5th anniversary this year. Get ready to unlock lots of exclusive rewards throughout the season. More information on www.ridersrepublic.com 

About Riders Republic:
Jump into a massive extreme sports multiplayer open-world across America’s National Parks. From bike races to snow parks and more, your journey starts now! Immerse yourself in iconic American national parks including Bryce Canyon, Yosemite Valley, Mammoth Mountain. Play solo or squad up with your friends and compete in a wide range of events, or give it your best shot in epic mass PvP races with 50+ other players.
